notes.mode: "live" renders the 3D clip stack, "poster" always shows the static image, "off" removes the scene entirely. Mobile, low-power devices, missing WebGL and reduced motion always get the poster.
notes.slabs: Number of clips in the stack, 5 to 7.
notes.accentIntensity: Strength of the green rim light and playhead glow. 0 turns the green off, 1.5 is the sensible maximum.
notes.frames: Which slab (0 = front) shows which edit. "src" is the small desaturated texture the scene loads; "source" is the thumbnail it is made from. After changing frames or slabs, run: node scripts/build-scene-assets.mjs
notes.poster: Static fallback, exported from the live scene by the same script. Keep the 2:1 ratio.
